meta.title: Savings strategies drop references with no value and compute the lot best amount by closing mode
gaps: Savings strategies and their references are not available as an operation or read-back field.
Lot-based versus line-by-line closing modes, budgets, last purchase price, and round-specific line configuration cannot be created or read with the available recipes and operations.
Best amounts, initial best amount, vendor savings columns, realised price drop/increase, and buyer performance awarded landed amounts are not available as read-back fields.
